macos.rationale: The installation documentation provides native macOS/Linux and Windows CLI installers. Scope is CLI/TUI operation, not a GUI desktop app.

ios.rationale: The complete scoped distribution/build tree ships CLI and browser console clients with no native iOS/Android app. Chat-service adapters are separate.

android.rationale: The complete scoped distribution/build tree ships CLI and browser console clients with no native iOS/Android app. Chat-service adapters are separate.

issue-tracking.rationale: The bounded current schema/CLI/forge inspection has external tracker references and workflow records, without native independent issues. The archived Python product is explicitly outside scope.

multiplayer.rationale: The explicit owner-only conversation contract rejects sending or starting work by another authenticated identity. This receipt scopes authenticated Web/CLI conversations; read-only run visibility is separate.

sso.rationale: Bounded built-in auth inspection provides email/password and trusted proxy/header mechanisms without an enterprise SAML/OIDC integration. A user-supplied identity proxy is not a product SSO feature.

review-ui.rationale: The bounded shipped view inspection has events/artifacts and approval controls, without a product-owned proposed-code/diff interface.
